name: arthur_prompt_injection_benchmark
description: A dataset of prompt-injection examples for evaluating whether models follow maliciously crafted instructions or safely refuse them. It contains prompts that attempt to override system instructions or exfiltrate information plus expected safe/benign responses, enabling measurement of model robustness to injection attacks. Useful for benchmarking and developing mitigation strategies for instruction-following models.
reputation: A small, community-driven dataset focused on prompt-injection research with limited but growing adoption among safety researchers.
